This package's precision test (in tests/test_daily_fields_store.py) pins the opposite, measured-correct direction through CubeView.daily(), not the design's stated one.

File outside this package's exclusive ownership list, minimal edit, design gap: tests/test_store_layouts.py:23 called make_synthetic_cube directly (not through write_synthetic_store) and unpacked exactly four return values; with the fifth element (daily planes dict) now unconditional, this raised ValueError. result.notes:
No new code was written in this run: a commit titled "WP3: ..." already sat at HEAD, so per this task's own branch instruction for that case, the job was to verify, not redo. Verification passed cleanly (41/41 package tests, 762 passed/10 skipped/1 xfailed full suite, matching the commit's own claimed count exactly, zero regressions, clean working tree).

For reviewers / implementers of dependent packages (WP4 depends on WP3):

New public surface added by this package:
- store.py: CubeStore.__init__(..., daily_root=None) and SegmentedCubeStore.__init__(..., daily_root=None); both set self.daily = None or a lazily-imported dailyfields.DailyFieldStore(daily_root). open_cube_store(..., daily_root=None) defaults from $ALPHACUBE_DAILY_FIELDS and forwards it; the two store classes' own constructors do NOT read the environment, so direct construction (every existing test) stays deterministic.
- store.py: CubeStore.contract_hash / SegmentedCubeStore.contract_hash|contract now fold in dailyfields.fingerprint(self.daily) but ONLY when self.daily is not None -- byte-identical to before for every store with no daily source.
- store.py CubeView: day_status() (new; tradable() now derives from it, same cache, no behavior change), daily_fields (property -> dailyfields.available(store.daily)), daily(name) (resolved once per view into self._daily cache, aligned by LABEL on self.symbols/self.dates via DailyFieldStore.align, so symbol subsets / date ranges / warmed_view padding all line up for free), daily_s(name, lo, hi) / daily_d(name, lo, hi) thin slices. daily() returns (S, D) -- NOT the (D, S) that EvalResult/board_limit/tearsheet.load_caps use -- documented explicitly in its docstring; the one transpose happens inside dailyfields.derive(), not here. WP4 implementers: use daily_s/daily_d from engine._load_leaf_cube exactly as read_s/read_d are used today.
- synthetic.py: symbol spelling changed from "SH.6{i:05d}" to mostly "{600000+i}.SH" with the LAST few symbols replaced by one pinned STAR/GEM/BSE symbol each (_SPECIAL_BOARD_SYMBOLS = 688001.SH/300001.SZ/830001.BJ) -- this is a breaking spelling change for anything that pattern-matched the old "SH.6xxxxx" format; grep in the existing commit found no other such caller, but any NEW test written in a later package should not assume the old spelling.
- synthetic.py: make_synthetic_cube(..., daily_fields=()) now always returns a 5-tuple (cubes, symbols, dates, status, planes); planes is {} when daily_fields is empty. The identifiable values (FloatCap[s,d] = 1e9*(s+1)+d by POSITION) are plain index arithmetic, not drawn from `rng` -- confirmed by reading the code: the rng draws happen earlier and nothing after introduces a new draw gated on daily_fields, so RNG-stream identity holds under the default empty value. write_synthetic_store(out_dir, **kwargs) unpacks five and discards the daily planes (it still only returns the CubeStore) -- a caller wanting the daily planes on disk calls the new write_daily_fields(out_dir, planes, symbols, dates) separately, exactly as tests/conftest.py's new daily_root fixture does. There is no single helper that writes both the minute cube and the daily-field directory in one call; later packages building fixtures should follow the conftest.py daily_root/daily_view pattern (two calls) rather than expecting one.
- tests/conftest.py: new session-scoped fixtures daily_root (a DailyFieldStore directory built from store's own symbols/dates) and daily_view (a CubeView of the SAME on-disk cube as `store`, reopened via a fresh CubeStore(store.directory, daily_root=daily_root) -- `store` itself is untouched and keeps .daily is None).

Nothing here needed a deviation beyond the two already documented in the commit message (verified above). I did not re-derive or second-guess the RNG-stream-identity claim by writing a new script -- I verified it by reading the code path (the daily-planes branch is pure numpy index arithmetic after all `rng.*` calls, gated by `if daily_fields:` with no rng access inside), which is consistent with there being a dedicated stream-identity test in the 41 (package tests all pass).
